name: Microsoft Windows installation media
description: Microsoft's official Windows 11/10 Media Creation Tool and installation-media guidance for creating Windows USB installation media on a supported working PC.
license_note: Windows installation and activation are governed by Microsoft's licence terms. Edition, hardware compatibility and product-key/digital-licence conditions apply.

tutorials.title: Create installation media for Windows
tutorials.scope: Official instructions for Windows installation USB creation and reinstall media.
notes: Microsoft requires a blank USB of at least 8 GB for the media creation workflow.
Creating installation media deletes existing content on the selected USB.
Back up the target PC before a clean install; clean installation can remove personal files and applications.
Microsoft's current Media Creation Tool for Windows 11 supports x64, not ARM-based PCs; check the official page for current ARM media options.
Use another working Windows PC to create media if the target PC cannot boot.
The selected USB will be erased; inspect its exact model and capacity before proceeding.
This tool does not install Windows on Android phones, iPhones, TVs or routers.
